protocol.test_policy: one closed phase after source and checkpoint suite freeze
protocol.training: all first-six-day exposures; natural class ratio; Adam or declared candidate optimizer/loss; scratch initialization
protocol.static_snapshot_assumption: Publisher-provided user/ad snapshots treated as static benchmark attributes. Their as-of dates are undocumented; this is not verified production point-in-time data.

context.budget_scope: all preparation, calibration, research calls, failures, controls and final assessment count

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: No local deep propagation-instability evidence is supplied; reliability gating/distillation would introduce an additional mechanism and capacity confound.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No reliability-aware transport, residual gate or distillation is implemented.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: The changed mechanism is a parameter-free occupied-group attention normalization on inherited local components.
assessments.falsifier: Reconsider only if later authorized diagnostics isolate consequential transport instability with matched-capacity controls.

assessments.rationale: Organizer-only component evidence; older-than-128 histories and business-domain identities are unavailable. Current groups are target-match partitions, not domains.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No older-history compression, local/global history expansion or domain exchange is implemented.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Within the same frozen 128 events, normalize per match group; no input-window change.
assessments.falsifier: Need authorized matched-event history contrasts and detailed primary implementation evidence before claiming this source transfers.

assessments.rationale: No observed token-construction bottleneck or detailed component ablation is supplied. Extra tokens would change capacity and cost.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No token projection, allocation or gated decoder is implemented.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Keep the complete original feature width and 16 appended coordinates; only weights over existing events change.
assessments.falsifier: Require a matched-capacity token construction contrast before attributing a local gain to this card.

assessments.rationale: Read exact-version primary lines 120-183 and 193-248. Local global target queries do not consistently beat history queries; a query-construction bottleneck is unestablished.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No generated query probes, NS refinement bridge, multiview pipeline or source optimizer is implemented.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: The candidate tests normalization of a simple inherited target query, with a same-allocation history-query replacement.
assessments.falsifier: If balanced_target fails to beat balanced_context, simple target-query utility stays unsupported; this does not refute the source full architecture.

assessments.rationale: Read primary lines 685-744: reported overlap between multi-channel pooling and cross-attention and AUC/Logloss disagreement motivate caution; local redundancy controls come from local model algebra.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No FM highway, multi-bus exchange, fusion module or distillation is implemented.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Uniform summaries are reconstructable local extra-path controls; no external architecture gain is imported.
assessments.falsifier: If uniform controls explain learned gains, learned retrieval adds no demonstrated predictive information; if they do not, redundancy remains a conditional alternative pending repetitions.

assessments.rationale: Only the exact-version author README lines 1-9 are readable; publisher paper remains blocked. Field warning is confirmed, full mechanism unverified.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No DMR-specific user/item matching module or unavailable historical item ID is introduced.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Respect category/brand/type/age inputs; implement a local matched-readout intervention.
assessments.falsifier: Full-paper/author-code inspection would be needed for a detailed DMR mechanism or priority comparison.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

source_access.query: grouped attention normalization behavior history target

context.final_assessment_scope: validation only; no test scores or predictions are supplied

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(meta, config) -> torch.nn.Module; forward(batch) -> finite [B] logits
optional: literal CONFIG dictionary for model dimensions/lr

Model.diagnostics(batch) -> at most 64 named finite scalars; host calls this on the first 512 validation impressions at the frozen best checkpoint, under no_grad. These are candidate-supplied measurements, requiring source-level scrutiny and controls.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls
